retainedEvidence.reason: Retained by user instruction against repeating passed tests. Subsequent native changes retain detached instances/meshes until both producer queues complete, exclude still-shared meshes from recycling, and avoid garbage-collection exceptions during failed-device teardown. These nine scenes contain no removed/replaced instances and had no device failure. Their exact measured DLL remains recorded; they are predecessor measurements rather than exact final-DLL reruns. The first two also predate a Java-only unsigned resource-ID CSV decoder correction, which is inactive in OFF/SUMMARY without GPU scopes.
